# Bot API coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/api-coverage.ts: run `bun run api-coverage`, do not edit by hand. -->

Which Bot API methods the [simulator](simulator.md) answers. The page is
generated by `bun run api-coverage` (`scripts/api-coverage.ts`), which
compares the simulator's methods with every method in grammY's types
(`@grammyjs/types`); a test fails when it is out of date, and another when
easytg itself calls a method the simulator doesn't answer. Other methods
fail with `404 Not Found: the simulator doesn't support the method`.

**121 of 185** methods are supported; the other 64 are not planned (new Bot API methods show up under "Planned").

## Supported

| Area | Methods |
|---|---|
| Getting updates and the bot (7) | `close`, `deleteWebhook`, `getMe`, `getUpdates`, `getWebhookInfo`, `logOut`, `setWebhook` |
| Payments (5) | `answerPreCheckoutQuery`, `answerShippingQuery`, `createInvoiceLink`, `refundStarPayment`, `sendInvoice` |
| Forum topics (13) | `closeForumTopic`, `closeGeneralForumTopic`, `createForumTopic`, `deleteForumTopic`, `editForumTopic`, `editGeneralForumTopic`, `getForumTopicIconStickers`, `hideGeneralForumTopic`, `reopenForumTopic`, `reopenGeneralForumTopic`, `unhideGeneralForumTopic`, `unpinAllForumTopicMessages`, `unpinAllGeneralForumTopicMessages` |
| Invite links and join requests (10) | `answerChatJoinRequestQuery`, `approveChatJoinRequest`, `createChatInviteLink`, `createChatSubscriptionInviteLink`, `declineChatJoinRequest`, `editChatInviteLink`, `editChatSubscriptionInviteLink`, `exportChatInviteLink`, `revokeChatInviteLink`, `sendChatJoinRequestWebApp` |
| Reactions (3) | `deleteAllMessageReactions`, `deleteMessageReaction`, `setMessageReaction` |
| Stickers (5) | `deleteChatStickerSet`, `getCustomEmojiStickers`, `getStickerSet`, `sendSticker`, `setChatStickerSet` |
| Sending messages (22) | `copyMessage`, `copyMessages`, `forwardMessage`, `forwardMessages`, `sendAnimation`, `sendAudio`, `sendChatAction`, `sendContact`, `sendDice`, `sendDocument`, `sendLocation`, `sendMediaGroup`, `sendMessage`, `sendMessageDraft`, `sendPhoto`, `sendPoll`, `sendRichMessage`, `sendRichMessageDraft`, `sendVenue`, `sendVideo`, `sendVideoNote`, `sendVoice` |
| Editing and deleting messages (14) | `deleteEphemeralMessage`, `deleteMessage`, `deleteMessages`, `editEphemeralMessageCaption`, `editEphemeralMessageMedia`, `editEphemeralMessageReplyMarkup`, `editEphemeralMessageText`, `editMessageCaption`, `editMessageLiveLocation`, `editMessageMedia`, `editMessageReplyMarkup`, `editMessageText`, `stopMessageLiveLocation`, `stopPoll` |
| Answering queries (5) | `answerCallbackQuery`, `answerInlineQuery`, `answerWebAppQuery`, `savePreparedInlineMessage`, `savePreparedKeyboardButton` |
| Bot settings (13) | `deleteMyCommands`, `getChatMenuButton`, `getMyCommands`, `getMyDefaultAdministratorRights`, `getMyDescription`, `getMyName`, `getMyShortDescription`, `setChatMenuButton`, `setMyCommands`, `setMyDefaultAdministratorRights`, `setMyDescription`, `setMyName`, `setMyShortDescription` |
| Chats and members (22) | `banChatMember`, `banChatSenderChat`, `deleteChatPhoto`, `getChat`, `getChatAdministrators`, `getChatMember`, `getChatMemberCount`, `getUserChatBoosts`, `leaveChat`, `pinChatMessage`, `promoteChatMember`, `restrictChatMember`, `setChatAdministratorCustomTitle`, `setChatDescription`, `setChatMemberTag`, `setChatPermissions`, `setChatPhoto`, `setChatTitle`, `unbanChatMember`, `unbanChatSenderChat`, `unpinAllChatMessages`, `unpinChatMessage` |
| Files (2) | `getFile`, `getUserProfilePhotos` |

## Not supported

### Planned

None.

### Not planned (outside a UI library)

| Group | Why | Methods |
|---|---|---|
| Business accounts | Bots acting for a Telegram Business account. | `deleteBusinessMessages`, `getBusinessAccountGifts`, `getBusinessAccountStarBalance`, `getBusinessConnection`, `readBusinessMessage`, `removeBusinessAccountProfilePhoto`, `setBusinessAccountBio`, `setBusinessAccountGiftSettings`, `setBusinessAccountName`, `setBusinessAccountProfilePhoto`, `setBusinessAccountUsername`, `transferBusinessAccountStars` |
| Stars, gifts, paid media, games, checklists and stories | Telegram-side economies and content a bot UI library does not draw. | `convertGiftToStars`, `deleteStory`, `editMessageChecklist`, `editStory`, `editUserStarSubscription`, `getAvailableGifts`, `getChatGifts`, `getGameHighScores`, `getMyStarBalance`, `getStarTransactions`, `getUserGifts`, `giftPremiumSubscription`, `postStory`, `repostStory`, `sendChecklist`, `sendGame`, `sendGift`, `sendPaidMedia`, `setGameScore`, `transferGift`, `upgradeGift` |
| Sticker sets | Creating and editing sticker sets is account management, not UI. | `addStickerToSet`, `createNewStickerSet`, `deleteStickerFromSet`, `deleteStickerSet`, `replaceStickerInSet`, `setCustomEmojiStickerSetThumbnail`, `setStickerEmojiList`, `setStickerKeywords`, `setStickerMaskPosition`, `setStickerPositionInSet`, `setStickerSetThumbnail`, `setStickerSetTitle`, `uploadStickerFile` |
| Managed bots | Bots that manage other bots. | `getManagedBotAccessSettings`, `getManagedBotToken`, `replaceManagedBotToken`, `setManagedBotAccessSettings` |
| Verification | Verifying users and chats on behalf of an organization. | `removeChatVerification`, `removeUserVerification`, `verifyChat`, `verifyUser` |
| Passport | Telegram Passport data. | `setPassportDataErrors` |
| Profiles, channel posts and guests | The bot's own profile, users' emoji status and profile media, live photos, suggested channel posts and guest queries: account features, not screens a bot draws. | `answerGuestQuery`, `approveSuggestedPost`, `declineSuggestedPost`, `getUserPersonalChatMessages`, `getUserProfileAudios`, `removeMyProfilePhoto`, `sendLivePhoto`, `setMyProfilePhoto`, `setUserEmojiStatus` |
